row.name: Magnite Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=1 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.21 tightness=1.17 base_volume_vs_leg=0.78 base_volume_vs_avg=1.57
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 1 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 22.6% vs its 20-SMA, 15.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 28.1% in 5 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: Two recorded FAILs anchor this setup: the base is a single session (outside Bonde's 3–20 minimum) and the burst bar's range is only 45% of the prior five bars' largest range, meaning there is no genuine range expansion. Visually the signal bar is a large green candle closing near its high after a sharp five-session leg, but the prior leg itself is steep and the 'base' is literally one day, so there is no consolidation to burst from. The move is also 22.6% extended over the 20-SMA with prior breakouts working 0 of 3, adding meaningful follow-through risk.
claude.key_risk: No real consolidation (1-session base) and failed range expansion mean the burst lacks the orderly setup structure Bonde requires, and the stock is already extended.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps more than 1% above the signal close (~$29.33) or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close (~$27.39).
